cohort: Patients who delivered by cesarean from 2004 to 2010 (n=5,144)
finding: The risks of organ injury and hysterectomy are increased after two or more prior cesareans, and risks of hemorrhage and surgical site complications are increased after three or more cesareans.
mod_finding: The risks of organ injury and hysterectomy are increased in women who have had two or more prior cesareans, and risks of hemorrhage and surgical site complications are increased after three or more cesareans.
